name: Wanaka Studio
short_description: AI-native 3D game studio that turns a written idea into a playable browser game, with a visual editor.
short_description_fr: Studio de jeux 3D par IA : tu décris une idée, tu obtiens un jeu jouable dans le navigateur, avec un éditeur visuel.
long_description: Wanaka Studio is an all-in-one AI game engine: you describe a game, an agent builds a playable 3D version, and you can keep directing the AI or edit the world in a synced visual editor. No coding is required. The studio covers characters, environments, animations, audio and interfaces, with auto-rigging, multiplayer and one-click publish to a browser link. Official plans are Free, Pro, MAX and Ultra (monthly or yearly).
features: Prompt-to-playable 3D game; synced visual editor; AI team for assets, audio and promotion; auto-rigging and multiplayer; 1-click browser publish; Free, Pro, MAX and Ultra plans

name: Teamily AI
short_description: AI-native messenger where people and always-on agents work together in shared chats, studios and memory.
short_description_fr: Messagerie native IA où humains et agents travaillent ensemble, avec mémoire partagée et studios collaboratifs.
long_description: Teamily AI is a human–agent platform built as an AI-native messenger for multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. People and agents share 1:1 chats, group threads, a public feed and collaborative studios for web apps, slides, docs and dashboards. Agents arrive with built-in capabilities, persistent living memory and a model router; you can also create custom agents or teams in natural language. Apps exist for web, iOS, Android, Windows and macOS.
features: Multi-user and multi-agent group chat; living memory; human-agent studios (web, slides, docs, dashboards); custom agents and teams; cross-device apps; public feed to remix agents

name: Tobira
short_description: Turns your website into a site agent that answers people and other AI agents, then books, sells or starts a trial.
short_description_fr: Transforme ton site en agent qui répond aux visiteurs et aux autres agents IA, puis réserve, vend ou ouvre un essai.
long_description: Tobira publishes a site agent from your pages and documents so it can answer visitors and incoming AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others) with structured facts, book meetings, take payment or send a trial link, and hand hard cases to your team. Leads can be sent to WhatsApp, Telegram, email or a CRM. A public Tobira network address is optional. Free plan uses your own OpenAI or OpenRouter key (up to 1,000 conversations/month).
features: Site agent for people and AI agents; booking and payments in chat; voice mode; knowledge from site and PDFs; lead alerts in messaging/CRM; optional agent network handle; MCP/API setup

name: Prelulu
short_description: Free-to-start app for text, voice and live video calls with AI characters you can pick or create.
short_description_fr: Applis de chat, d'appels vocaux et vidéo en direct avec des personnages IA, à choisir ou à créer, gratuite pour commencer.
long_description: Prelulu is a consumer app for chatting, calling and live video-calling original AI characters, including ones you create, with conversation memory that carries between text and calls. Official web pricing: a daily free text-message allowance forever, plus welcome and check-in credits that can fund a short call. In-app store prices are higher because of store fees.
features: Live real-time video avatar calls; voice calls; text chat with daily free allowance; create your own characters; conversation memory; credit packs; iPhone and Android apps

name: Videco
short_description: Hosts your videos and turns webinars, demos and recordings into AI clips, posts and lead-capture pages.
short_description_fr: Héberge tes vidéos et transforme webinars, démos et enregistrements en clips IA, posts et pages de capture de leads.
long_description: Videco is a video hosting and repurposing workspace. Content Studio finds standout moments in a demo, webinar or interview and produces vertical clips, blog drafts and social hooks, then you brand and export them. Hosting adds watch pages with VideoObject schema, personalized share links, booking embeds (Calendly or Cal.com) and a leads workspace with CSV export. New accounts get a 7-day free trial.
features: AI clip and copy generation; video hosting and embeds; VideoObject SEO markup; personalized landing URLs; lead capture and booking embeds; team seats and custom domain (Business)

name: Krev
short_description: Team of AI specialists that research, create content, run ads and help operate a Shopify ecommerce brand.
short_description_fr: Équipe de spécialistes IA qui recherchent, créent du contenu, gèrent les pubs et aident à piloter une marque Shopify.
long_description: Krev is an ecommerce growth suite whose named AI employees share one brand memory: Scout researches competitor ads, Luna creates product photos, UGC-style content and ads, Kai manages Meta and TikTok campaigns, Chloe schedules social posts, Toshi edits the Shopify store, Max works on SEO/AEO, and Rue handles email. You connect Shopify, ads and socials, brief a goal, then approve work before anything goes live. Enterprise is custom. First monthly payment has a conditional 7-day money-back guarantee.
features: Named AI employees for research, creative, ads, social, Shopify, SEO/AEO and email; Brand DNA from your site; approval-before-publish; Meta and TikTok connectors; MCP access on Team+

name: Rerun
short_description: No-code team of AI coworkers that run recurring business tasks 24/7, with human approval and a private cloud machine.
short_description_fr: Équipe de collègues IA no-code qui exécutent tes tâches récurrentes 24h/24, avec validation humaine et machine cloud privée.
long_description: Rerun lets you install no-code “Coworkers” that run around the clock on a private cloud machine for each workspace—chasing invoices, qualifying leads or clearing an inbox—while you watch every step and they pause before sensitive actions. You can use the included models, connect your own API key, or plug in an existing ChatGPT or Claude subscription. Enterprise is custom.
features: No-code recurring agents; real-time step view and approval gates; private workspace server; BYO ChatGPT/Claude/API key; 3,000+ app/MCP connectors; unlimited seats on Pro

name: Rainbrand
short_description: Brand layer that keeps shared identity, guidance and assets current for your AI agents and products.
short_description_fr: Couche de marque qui maintient à jour l'identité, les consignes et les visuels partagés pour tes agents et produits IA.
long_description: Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files, then gives agents the guidance and assets they need for campaigns, sites, slides, email and video. You can use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or embed it in a product through the API. Credit top-ups are billed at plan rates listed on the pricing page.
features: Brand context from sites, guides and files; assets for campaigns and creative work; Claude/ChatGPT/Codex/Cursor access; API and MCP on every plan; credit-based usage

name: Stitch.ai
short_description: All-in-one AI workspace for mail, calendar, notes, tasks, files and more, with the Stitchy assistant built in.
short_description_fr: Espace de travail IA tout-en-un pour mail, calendrier, notes, tâches et fichiers, avec l'assistant Stitchy intégré.
long_description: Stitch.ai brings mail, calendar, contacts, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards and files into one workspace, without a separate email client or third-party integrations to set up. Dual panels let you drag items together; Knots, tags and connections keep work organized. Stitchy, the built-in assistant, works across those surfaces.
features: Built-in mail, calendar, tasks, notes, sheets, slides, boards and files; Stitchy AI assistant; dual workspace panels; Knots, tags and connections; 7-day full-feature trial

name: Turnstone
short_description: Free Mac app for persistent AI agents that run on the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok subscription you already pay for.
short_description_fr: Applis Mac gratuite pour des agents IA persistants, branchés sur l'abonnement ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou Grok que tu as déjà.
long_description: Turnstone is a macOS app for persistent AI agents with local memory you can open and correct. It runs on the AI subscription or API key you already have (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok) and can switch models when a limit is hit; prepaid Turnstone Credits are available if you have no key. The Mac app is free forever, with no card required for the Chief of Staff and free app connectors. Teams under 10 are offered 30 days free, as stated on the site.
features: Persistent Mac agents with local memory; BYO ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok; model failover; free app connectors

name: Dageno AI
short_description: GEO platform that shows how AI systems represent your brand, then helps you fix visibility gaps with agents.
short_description_fr: Plateforme GEO qui montre comment les IA parlent de ta marque, puis t'aide à corriger les trous de visibilité avec des agents.
long_description: Dageno AI is a generative-engine-optimization data and agent platform. It combines signals from your site, traffic, prompts, social and mentions to show why AI systems recommend competitors, and it can run agent-powered fixes and track progress. The site also offers free AI visibility tools and a free SEO/GEO/AEO report. Product Hunt’s 2.0 launch noted a free trial with no credit card.
features: AI visibility and GEO monitoring; gap analysis across content and sources; agent-powered execution; free visibility tools and report; Starter, Growth and Scale plans

name: Voyager
short_description: macOS file browser that finds your files and lets AI agents work with them as context, without a separate upload.
short_description_fr: Explorateur de fichiers macOS qui retrouve tes fichiers et les donne en contexte à tes agents IA, sans envoi séparé.
long_description: Voyager is an agentic file browser for macOS: you search and organize files in a familiar browser, then work with AI agents that use those files as context. The company says files are not uploaded to a separate store and are not sold for ads. Subscription costs for the AI providers you connect are paid to those providers.
features: macOS agentic file browser; file search and tabbed organization; work with files as agent context; no separate upload; Free plan available now

name: Pauta
short_description: Private, offline meeting and voice-note recorder that transcribes, summarizes and lists actions on your device.
short_description_fr: Enregistreur privé et hors ligne pour réunions et notes vocales : transcription, résumé et actions, le tout sur l'appareil.
long_description: Pauta records and transcribes meetings, interviews and voice notes, then turns them into summaries and action items. It works fully offline and keeps data on the device, connecting to external AI only if you choose. Apps are available for Mac and Windows. After the trial you can buy from the site checkout.
features: On-device recording and transcription; summaries and action items; fully offline by default; optional external AI; Mac and Windows apps; 7-day trial without a card

name: AXL
short_description: GTM platform for AI-product founders: pages, quizzes, webinars, CRM, AI calls and 1,200+ actions via MCP.
short_description_fr: Plateforme GTM pour fondateurs de produits IA : pages, quiz, webinars, CRM, appels IA et plus de 1 200 actions via MCP.
long_description: AXL is an all-in-one go-to-market system that combines landing pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting, email, chat, CRM, telephony and AI calls, so each interaction adds to the lead record. It scores leads with a model the company says was trained on 1M deals and 300+ signals, and it exposes lead context plus 1,200+ sales and marketing actions to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor via MCP.
features: Pages, quizzes, webinars and courses; email, chat and CRM; telephony and AI calls; lead scoring; 1,200+ actions via MCP for ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor; Free plan with hard limits

name: DocsAlot
short_description: Turns help-center and developer docs into one source of truth for humans and AI agents, with MCP, llms.txt and a support bot.
short_description_fr: Regroupe docs support et développeurs en une source unique pour humains et agents IA, avec MCP, llms.txt et un bot d'assistance.
long_description: DocsAlot unifies scattered help-center articles, knowledge bases and developer docs so people and AI agents read the same source. It includes hosted MCP, llms.txt and skill.md, and a Slack and Discord bot that answers customer questions from those docs. Enterprise is custom (not self-serve checkout).
features: Unified docs for humans and agents; hosted MCP; llms.txt and skill.md; Slack and Discord answer bot; public and private doc surfaces (Team); Startup and Team self-serve plans

name: Agent Clan
short_description: Puts Claude Code and Codex agents on your screen as a 3D team you steer with gestures, voice or a mouse.
short_description_fr: Affiche tes agents Claude Code et Codex en équipe 3D à l'écran, dirigée au geste, à la voix ou à la souris.
long_description: Agent Clan is a desktop app for Mac and Windows that shows your Claude Code and Codex agents as a 3D team on the screen. You can summon them with a fist, pinch to select one, speak a request, swipe to allow or deny a permission prompt, or circle something on screen to hand it over. A leader can split work across a crew. Hand tracking and voice run on the computer; everything also works with a mouse.
features: 3D on-screen agent team; gesture and voice control; permission allow/deny gestures; screen-region handoff; mouse fallback; Free plan; Pro one-time purchase; Mac and Windows

name: Crystl
short_description: macOS terminal for running and orchestrating multiple AI coding agents, with git worktrees, schedules and SSH.
short_description_fr: Terminal macOS pour lancer et orchestrer plusieurs agents de code IA, avec worktrees git, planifications et SSH.
long_description: Crystl is a macOS terminal built for CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Kimi and OpenCode. It supports multi-vendor, multi-agent orchestration and a super-orchestrator that can manage other orchestrators across projects. Built-in capabilities listed on the site include git worktree isolation, SSH, task management, agent status monitoring, automations, scheduled agents and an agent-usable CLI.
features: Multi-agent macOS terminal; Claude Code, Codex, Kimi and OpenCode; git worktree isolation; SSH; scheduled agents; super-orchestration on Guild

name: Rankfender
short_description: SEO and GEO platform that audits your site, publishes articles, and checks how major AI assistants talk about your brand.
short_description_fr: Plateforme SEO et GEO qui audite ton site, publie des articles et vérifie comment les grands assistants IA parlent de ta marque.
long_description: Rankfender combines keyword research, rank tracking (including AI Overviews), competitor and backlink analysis, site audits, content and social, and checks how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Grok, Llama and Mistral answer buyer questions (via official APIs). You can work in the app or connect Claude or ChatGPT so an agent can run it. Essential covers 1 brand, 15 AI prompts weekly in 5 of 8 assistants, 5 articles a month and a site audit up to 10 pages.
features: Site audit for Google and AI engines; keyword and rank tracking; AI-assistant brand checks (up to 8 models); AI articles to WordPress; agent access via Claude or ChatGPT

name: Glasshand
short_description: Rents a dedicated real iPhone or Mac in a data center so your AI agent can use it like you would, then wipes the device.
short_description_fr: Loue un iPhone ou un Mac réel, dédié, en datacenter, pour que ton agent IA s'en serve comme toi, puis efface l'appareil.
long_description: Glasshand rents physical iPhones and Macs, hosted in its data center, to AI agents. You connect Claude Code, Codex or another agent and it can rent a device with a prompt, then use it for tasks such as posting on TikTok, booking an Uber, or building and testing iOS apps. Each device is yours alone for the rental period; when you are done, Glasshand says it erases your data and factory-resets the hardware.
features: Dedicated real iPhone or Mac rental; works with Claude Code, Codex and other agents; single-tenant device; data wipe and factory reset at the end; monthly pricing

name: seam
short_description: Mac app that turns the notch into a Dynamic Island for on-device dictation, music, a focus timer and Claude Code status.
short_description_fr: Applis Mac qui transforme l'encoche en Dynamic Island : dictée locale, musique, minuteur de focus et statut de Claude Code.
long_description: seam is a native macOS utility that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island-style control center. Features listed by the maker include on-device voice-to-text dictation into any app, music controls, calendar, a focus timer, battery status, and a notification when Claude Code finishes.
features: Notch Dynamic Island UI; on-device dictation into any app; music and calendar controls; focus timer; Claude Code completion status; 48-hour trial with no card

name: fileAI
short_description: Turns files into structured, checked data for AI agents, with fraud signals and outcome-based billing for completed flows.
short_description_fr: Transforme tes fichiers en données structurées et contrôlées pour les agents IA, avec signaux de fraude et facturation à l'issue.
long_description: fileAI extracts structured data from files and adds fraud and AI-generated-content checks, then runs Agent Flows that apply rules, reconcile documents and post results via UI, API or MCP. The Product Hunt launch highlighted fileForensics, the file-trust checks, as part of this platform.
features: Zero-shot file extraction; fraud and AI-content checks (fileForensics); Agent Flows with outcome-based billing; API, MCP and UI

name: RoomLab
short_description: Turns a photo of a room into a photorealistic redesign, virtual staging or a short video, using credits.
short_description_fr: Transforme la photo d’une pièce en relooking photoréaliste, home staging virtuel ou courte vidéo, avec un système de crédits.
long_description: RoomLab is a web app for interior redesign and virtual home staging: you start from a photo of a room, change furniture or materials, tidy a space or furnish a property, and can also generate short videos. The official English plan page (checked from Europe/Madrid) prices a first free image, then a one-time Personal plan at €9.99 for 150 credits (about 15 images or 3 videos, no renewal), and monthly Pro €14.99, Ultra €39.99 and Premium €89.99 (yearly Pro €149 and Ultra €399 also listed; unused subscription credits are saved if you cancel). Each image uses about 10 credits, and 4K adds about 10 more. Browsers may be geo-redirected to a language path such as /es.
features: Photo-to-interior redesign and virtual staging; short video generations; 1 free image; Personal €9.99 one-time (150 credits); Pro/Ultra/Premium monthly or yearly; unused subscription credits kept after cancel; 4K upscale uses extra credits

name: CaughtTheMagic
short_description: Uploads a photo of your living room and returns a Santa cam still or video, with a free preview before you buy credits.
short_description_fr: À partir d’une photo de ton salon, crée un cliché ou une vidéo type caméra de Noël avec un aperçu gratuit avant d’acheter des crédits.
long_description: CaughtTheMagic turns a photo of your home into a doorbell, night-vision or security-cam style image of Santa by the tree, and can turn that into a video. You can try a free preview of your own room with no account. There is no subscription: 1 photo uses 1 credit and 1 video uses 4. Failed renders return credits; unused credits can be refunded on request.
features: Free room preview, no account needed; Santa doorbell, night-vision and security-cam styles; photo and video outputs; credit packs (no subscription); promo prices until 1 Dec; automatic credit refunds on failed renders

name: Blocksona
short_description: Turns a selfie, a pet photo or a short description into a 64×64 Minecraft skin you can preview in 3D and download.
short_description_fr: Transforme un selfie, la photo de ton animal ou une courte description en skin Minecraft 64×64, à prévisualiser en 3D et à télécharger.
long_description: Blocksona generates 64×64 Minecraft skins from a selfie, a pet photo or a short text description, with a 3D preview and downloads for Java and Bedrock. Official pricing: 1 credit makes 1 skin; new accounts get 3 free credits valid 365 days, and failed skins are refunded. The site’s pricing page lists datePublished 2026-10-22 and dateModified 2026-11-06.
features: Selfie, pet or text-to-Minecraft-skin; 64×64 Java and Bedrock downloads; 3D preview; 3 free credits (365 days); failed skins refunded

name: Glass
short_description: Records your Mac screen and uses monthly AI credit to edit, chat and add voiceover, then gives you a shareable demo link.
short_description_fr: Enregistre l’écran de ton Mac et utilise un crédit IA mensuel pour monter, discuter du rush et ajouter une voix off, puis te donne un lien de démo.
long_description: Glass is a macOS screen recorder (made for Apple silicon) that can edit while you talk: you record, hit Stop, and get a polished demo link. Recording, manual editing and export stay free. The early-access half price is kept for as long as you stay subscribed. Distinct from Glasshand in this same lot.
features: Mac screen recording and AI edit/chat/voiceover; automatic redaction on paid plans

name: Longformly
short_description: Turns a script into a finished long YouTube-style video with narration, scenes, motion and sound, after a free preview.
short_description_fr: Transforme un script en vidéo YouTube longue terminée, avec narration, scènes, mouvement et son, après un aperçu gratuit.
long_description: Longformly is a long-form AI video generator for YouTube: you paste a script and get a finished video up to 60 minutes, with narration, scenes, gentle motion and sound. There is no subscription. Failed renders are never charged.
features: Script to finished long-form video (up to 60 minutes); narration, scenes, motion and sound; free 10-second preview; no subscription; failed renders not charged

name: JingleLark
short_description: Writes radio jingles from a line of text, lets you pick a voice, and mix intro, bed and outro for free; credits pay for voiceovers.
short_description_fr: Crée des jingles radio à partir d’une phrase, te laisse choisir une voix, et mixer intro, fond et outro gratuitement ; les crédits paient les voix off.
long_description: JingleLark is an AI jingle maker for small radio stations and DJs: you type a line, pick a radio voice, and mix it with an intro, bed and outro. Mixing and downloads are always free; voiceovers use credits that never expire, with full commercial rights and MP3/WAV download. Every voice is included on every pack.
features: Text-to-radio-jingle; free unlimited mixing and rebuilds; MP3/WAV and commercial rights; credits never expire; all voices on every pack

name: Aeterna
short_description: Records your voice, stories and memories so family can keep talking with you later, starting on a free plan.
short_description_fr: Enregistre ta voix, tes histoires et tes souvenirs pour que ta famille puisse continuer à t’entendre, en commençant par une offre gratuite.
long_description: Aeterna is a life-story product: you record voice, wisdom and memories so family members can hear you later, including after you are gone. All listed software plans include AES-256 encryption, a private vault, unlimited story topics and mobile access; you can cancel anytime and memories stay after cancellation.
features: Voice and memory recording for family; AES-256 vault

name: Embage
short_description: Puts a chat or voice agent on your website or Telegram that can talk to visitors, act in your tools, and review the conversation afterwards.
short_description_fr: Place un agent chat ou voix sur ton site ou Telegram, qui parle aux visiteurs, agit dans tes outils, puis relit la conversation ensuite.
long_description: Embage is a builder for customer chat and voice agents on your website and Telegram. An agent can talk with visitors, act in your tools, and a post-conversation subagent analyses what happened after they leave. Voice is priced per session. Paid plans include Embage credits.
features: Website and Telegram chat/voice agents; post-conversation subagent analysis; Free plan with your own API key; voice priced per session; Enterprise listed

name: AI Grammatic
short_description: Rewrites selected text anywhere on a Mac with one shortcut, for grammar, tone and translation.
short_description_fr: Réécrit le texte sélectionné n’importe où sur un Mac avec un raccourci, pour la grammaire, le ton et la traduction.
long_description: AI Grammatic (also called GrammaticAI) is a macOS writing assistant: you select text anywhere and press ⌘⌥E to rewrite it for grammar, tone or translation. The product is Mac-only.
features: System-wide Mac shortcut (⌘⌥E); grammar, tone and translation rewrites; 50,000 words a day; choice of model

name: Buzzmark
short_description: Reads your website, then writes, plans, schedules and measures social posts in that voice, after a 7-day free trial.
short_description_fr: Lit ton site, puis écrit, planifie, programme et mesure tes posts sociaux dans ta voix, après 7 jours d’essai gratuit.
long_description: Buzzmark is an AI social ghostwriter and scheduler for founders and growing businesses. It learns a voice from the company website, then writes, plans, schedules, publishes and measures posts (a “Buzz” is one new piece it writes). Official pricing: 7 days free, then plans at €29, €49 and €99 a month excluding VAT. The pricing page also describes a limited launch offer: monthly launch prices of €36.75 and €74.25 for the first 12 months, then €49 and €99; yearly first year €294 or €594 (half of twelve months), then the regular yearly rate. The official organization is Piik Labs AB in Göteborg, Sweden. It is not the email service at buzzmarkapp.com or the advertising company at buzzmark.com.
features: Writes, plans, schedules and measures social posts from your website voice; 7-day free trial; plans €29, €49 and €99 / month excl. VAT; limited launch pricing also listed; Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, TikTok integrations named on the site

name: Toozi
short_description: Handles books, invoices, savings reminders and e-filing for US self-employed people by text.
short_description_fr: Gère comptabilité, factures, rappels d’épargne et télédéclaration pour les indépendants US par SMS.
long_description: Toozi is an SMS tax app for the US self-employed: it keeps books (separate books per hustle), sends invoices, tells you what to save, and e-files a federal return (Form 1040 with supporting forms, as described on the pricing FAQ). Cancel anytime, per the official FAQ.
features: Taxes by text for the US self-employed; bookkeeping and invoices; quarterly estimates and savings prompts; federal e-file (Form 1040); 14-day free trial, no card

name: Nuvio
short_description: AI-native finance software that invoices, scans receipts, reconciles and analyses cash flow, with optional bookkeeping and sales-tax filing.
short_description_fr: Logiciel finance basé sur l’IA qui facture, scanne les reçus, rapproche les comptes et analyse la trésorerie, avec comptabilité et TVA en option.
long_description: Nuvio is AI-native finance software with invoicing, payment tracking, AI receipt and invoice scanning, AI-powered reconciliation, analytics, cash flow, project financials, multi-currency and an AI assistant. Each plan is offered with a “Start for free” action on the pricing page. This is a 5.0-era product that appeared on Product Hunt around 27 October 2026 (widened window) and was not already in the restore3-new catalogue.
features: AI receipt/invoice scanning and reconciliation; invoicing, cash-flow analytics and assistant; “Start for free” on the official pricing page

name: PlotStudio AI
short_description: An agentic analytics workspace where AI agents prepare, analyse and visualise data, and connect findings across analyses.
short_description_fr: Un espace d’analytique agentique où des agents IA préparent, analysent et visualisent tes données, et relient les résultats d’une analyse à l’autre.
long_description: PlotStudio AI is an agentic analytics workspace for researchers and enterprise teams: agents prepare, analyse and visualise data and connect findings across analyses. Official pricing: a Free Trial gives 30 credits, no credit card and no API key, plus direct team access and onboarding support.
features: Agentic prepare/analyse/visualise workspace; Free Trial 30 credits, no card; onboarding and direct team access on listed plans

name: fridgesnap.AI
short_description: Takes a photo of your fridge and returns personalized recipes in three cuisines from the ingredients it sees.
short_description_fr: Prend une photo de ton frigo et te propose des recettes personnalisées, dans trois cuisines, à partir des ingrédients détectés.
long_description: fridgesnap.AI is a food app: you snap a photo of your fridge and get personalized recipes, with three cuisines crafted from the ingredients in the photo, plus dietary preferences. Monthly and annual plans start with a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime is stated for the monthly plan.
features: Fridge-photo to recipes; three cuisines per scan and dietary preferences; 7-day free trial on monthly/annual

name: StoreToAds
short_description: Builds ads from your real product photos, on demand or on a schedule, with a free preview before paid plans.
short_description_fr: Crée des publicités à partir de tes vraies photos produit, à la demande ou en envoi programmé, avec un aperçu gratuit avant les offres payantes.
long_description: StoreToAds is an AI ad generator for online stores, built around your real product photos, with on-demand creation or scheduled delivery.
features: Ads from real product photos; on-demand or scheduled delivery; free preview (3 ads, no signup)

name: BaseTab
short_description: Turns a new browser tab into a workspace with widgets, bookmarks, AI chat and Google integrations, with a free plan.
short_description_fr: Transforme un nouvel onglet de navigateur en espace de travail avec widgets, favoris, chat IA et intégrations Google, avec une offre gratuite.
long_description: BaseTab is a new-tab workspace (Chrome and other browsers are listed) with customizable widgets, bookmarks, AI chat, Google integrations and other productivity tools.
features: New-tab workspace with widgets, bookmarks and AI chat; Google integrations; unlimited workspaces and up to 10-person team on Pro
